audit_area: application security (API authorization, CORS, general defects)

findings.title: IDOR on /api/tickets/[id] — no org_id check
findings.correlation_note: access-log.txt shows a sequential ID sweep across 3 different orgs, all returning 200 — but no separate confirmed large-scale data exfiltration via this specific path (the direct customers-table pull covers the same data more directly).
findings.detail: GET and PATCH both authenticate the session but never verify the requested ticket belongs to that session's org. See api-tickets-route.js.
findings.recommended_fix: Add `AND org_id = $session.org_id` to every query keyed by a client-supplied ID. Consider row-level security as a second, defense-in-depth layer here too.

findings.title: CORS wildcard on /api/*
findings.correlation_note: Confirmed present (next-config-cors.txt) and confirmed in the response headers during the incident, but not independently evidenced as the delivery mechanism for the actual breach.
findings.detail: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on every API route, added as a quick fix during development and never scoped down.
findings.recommended_fix: Allowlist only app.loopline.io and known preview-deployment domains.

findings.title: Exposed /api/debug/seed with no auth
findings.correlation_note: access-log.txt shows exactly one external hit, no evidence of repeated or damaging use.
findings.detail: Leftover Lovable scaffolding route that reseeds/wipes demo data, reachable in production with no authentication.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove debug/seed routes before production deploy, or gate them behind an admin-only auth check plus an environment check (never respond in production).

findings.title: General OWASP-flavored defects (reflected XSS, no rate-limiting)
findings.correlation_note: Consistent with Veracode's 2026 finding that ~44-45% of AI code-generation tasks contain a detectable OWASP Top 10 flaw — a general elevated-defect-rate pattern, not something uniquely wrong with Loopline.
findings.detail: See code-scan-summary.txt for the two specific findings.
findings.recommended_fix: Sanitize rendered user content (ticket comments); add rate limiting to /api/auth/login.
